prompt:
You will get 5 images, each a strip cut from one video frame, stacked top to bottom:
(1) a caption box burned into the video, (2) a green LED test timer, (3) a data-acquisition clock line.
For each image, in the order given, transcribe exactly what is shown:
- "caption": the caption text verbatim (e.g. "Normal (Power On)", "100x speed (Venting)"), or null if none
- "led": the LED timer digits as shown, formatted H:MM:SS (the small digits at the right are seconds), or null if unreadable
- "daq_datetime": the date-time at the start of the clock line verbatim (MM/DD/YY HH:MM:SS.mmm), or null
- "daq_epoch": the second number on the clock line (a Unix time with decimals) verbatim as a string, or null
Return ONLY a JSON array of 5 objects with keys "i" (0-based image index), "caption", "led", "daq_datetime", "daq_epoch".
